patient._comment: 'patient' is info about the patient: personal, clinical, vitals are shown on the patient card during the game; diagnosis is used for potential 'patient review' card.

clinical.quoteLong: (Son) She's a diabetic and she's been getting more and more out of it over a week — so sleepy, so thirsty, peeing constantly. Her skin looks all dried up. Now she barely responds.
clinical.presentationShort: 80yo F diabetic — days of polyuria/polydipsia, profound dehydration, lethargy, glucose very high, no ketosis — HHS.
clinical.presentationLong: 80-year-old diabetic female with a week of polyuria and polydipsia, profound dehydration, and progressive lethargy, with a markedly elevated glucose and no significant ketosis — hyperosmolar hyperglycemic state.

diagnosis.disposition: Acute → aggressive IV fluids, cautious insulin, electrolytes, find the trigger; monitor closely.
diagnosis.why: HHS = huge glucose, huge dehydration, altered, minimal ketones. Fluids are the priority, then careful insulin.
diagnosis.redFlag: Elder diabetic + profound dehydration + altered + very high glucose = HHS.

answer._comment: 'answer' is answer for the game scoring.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character, 3/4 front view, centered, square 1:1. Match the exact painterly style, brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting, and palette of the attached reference image. Subject: a hispanic 80-year-old woman, frail and dehydrated, slumped drowsily on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: slumped and barely responsive. Expression: drowsy with sunken features. Clearly visible: sunken, drowsy features and dry cracked lips. No text, no logos.
